title: Day 4: an AI turned my to-do list into a tower defense #shorts
description:
Your to-dos march on your castle.

Deadline Defense is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Every deadline becomes a little foe walking toward your castle — the closer it is, the sooner it's due. Actually finish the task, tap Done, and your tower fires. Big tasks are big foes: split them into small steps and each one falls in a single shot. Miss a deadline and it just rolls into tomorrow's wave. A gentle defense for procrastinators.

Deadline Defense - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 5 tomorrow.

#productivity #todolist #procrastination #towerdefense #indiegame
